high_level_description: The image shows a hand holding a blue box containing four cigars. The box is labeled "Richard" at the top in large, gold-colored letters with decorative elements on either side. Below the name, there are four cigars wrapped in brown tobacco leaves, each individually packaged in clear plastic sleeves. Each cigar has a gold band around its middle that reads "Hecho a Mano Reserva" and features a shield emblem with a red background and a gold "B" in the center. The cigars are neatly arranged in the box, which appears to be designed for presentation or gifting.
